products.title: Products
products.intro: Add a new product or change an old one. A product goes on the shop only when its checklist is complete.
products.emptyAll: No products yet — add the first one.

kpi.needPhotosSub: fewer than {n}, or a kind missing
kpi.marginNoFloor: on the shop, buying price to selling price
kpi.needPhotosSub2: front photo missing for a colour

search.label: Search products
search.placeholder: Search name, style code or SKU

bulk.label: Change the selected products
bulk.confirmArchive: Archive {n} products? They leave the list. Nothing is deleted and you can restore them.
bulk.someDone: {done} done, {failed} not done — see the list above.
bulk.tooMany: At most {max} products in one go.

edit.intro: Change what you need and press "Save changes". The shop changes only for a product that is on it.

new.title: New product
new.intro: Start with the name, category and fabric. Colours, sizes, prices and photos come next, on the product's own page.
new.sub: The product starts as a draft: it is not on the shop yet.
new.created: Created — now add colours, sizes and photos.
new.note: Nothing goes on the shop from here.
new.readyNote: After you create it, this card shows what is still missing before it can go on the shop.

sections.namingSub: Leave a field empty to use the shop's template. A changed link forwards the old one by itself.
sections.coloursSub: {n} on this product, in the order the shop shows them
sections.sizesSub: Pick the sizes; each colour gets a box per size below. Taking a size off retires its SKUs — kept, never deleted.
sections.variantsSub: One box per colour and size

fields.nameHelp: Customers read this name on cards, the product page and the bag.
fields.styleHelp: The ERP's code for this style; suggested SKUs start with it.
fields.sizeChartNone: None yet — set it on the size charts page.
fields.templateHint: Empty = the shop's template (shown in grey).
fields.focusKeywordHelp: The word customers search for. The Google score checks it is in the title or description. Empty: the category name ({word}) is used.

aiDescription.confirmOverwrite: This will replace the English description already typed here. Continue?
aiDescription.done: AI wrote a draft below — review it, then Save changes.

reason.AI_OFF: AI is off right now (Settings → AI).
reason.NOT_READY: No AI connection is ready yet.
reason.CAP_EXCEEDED: This month's AI spending cap has been reached.
reason.NO_ANSWER: AI could not write a description just now — try again.

colours.added: {name} added to the colour library and this product.
colours.similar: {name} added — it looks close to {other}; check it is not the same colour.

variants.filled: {n} SKUs filled in — check them against the ERP.
variants.nothingToFill: Every new box already has a SKU.
variants.needStyle: Type the style code first; the suggestion starts with it.
variants.pricesLocked: Only people allowed to set prices can change them.
variants.none: Add a colour and pick sizes to make SKUs.
variants.note: Stock comes from the ERP; it is shown here, not typed. A box without a SKU is not made. Prices are typed in whole units.

photos.confirmOff: Take this photo off the product? It stays in the media library.
photos.removed: Photo taken off; it stays in the library.
photos.noRead: You cannot see the media library; ask the owner.
photos.noUpload: You can see the photos but not add them.

publish.confirmOff: Take this product off the shop? Its page and everything else stay.
publish.confirmArchive: Archive this product? Nothing is deleted and you can restore it.
publish.published: It is on the shop now.
publish.readyNote: The checklist is complete: it can go on the shop.
publish.blockedNote: It can go on the shop when every "must" item below is done.
publish.liveNote: Customers can see and buy it.
publish.liveFailing: It is on the shop but something is missing now — see below.
publish.archivedNote: Archived: not on the shop and not in the list.
publish.noPermission: You cannot put products on the shop; ask the owner.

ready.note: Reminders do not stop publishing; "must" items do.

save.note: Changes are saved only when you press Save.
save.dirty: You have changes that are not saved.

errors.BELOW_FLOOR: The price is below the lowest price allowed over the buying price ({fields}). Raise the price, or change the lowest margin in the Products settings.
errors.CONFLICT: This cannot be done in its current state.
errors.NOT_FOUND: It was not found; it may have been changed meanwhile.
errors.SKU_TAKEN: This SKU is already used by another product: {fields}
errors.SKU_RETIRED: This SKU belonged to a retired garment and is never reused: {fields}
errors.SKU_FORMAT: This SKU does not match the shop's SKU pattern: {fields}
errors.VARIANT_EXISTS: There is already a SKU for this colour and size.
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: This link is used elsewhere; choose another.
errors.SLUG_RESERVED: This link is reserved; choose another.
errors.COLOUR_IN_USE: This colour still has SKUs on sale; take its sizes off first.
errors.NAME_TAKEN: That colour name is already in the library.
errors.UNKNOWN_KEY: A value is not in its list: {fields}
errors.PARENT_ARCHIVED: The category or fabric is archived.
errors.TOO_MANY_CHANGES: Too many products in one go.
errors.NOT_AN_IMAGE: This file is not a photo.
errors.TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This kind of file is not allowed.
errors.TOO_SMALL: The photo is too small for the shop.
errors.ARCHIVED: This file is archived; restore it first.

pm.dropHelp: Drop many photos here, paste one (Ctrl+V), or choose them. They go to the colour picked above.
pm.needLook: {count} photo(s) need a look (see the notes on them).
pm.fixed: Photo fixed. The old file stays in the library.
pm.needNew: This one needs a new photo.
pm.dragHelp: Drag a photo to change the order. The first one is the main photo.
pm.empty: No photo for this colour yet.
pm.title: Photos

checks.d: Plain checks on each photo: too small, blurry, too dark, wrong shape, cut off. No AI is used.
checks.onHelp: Shows a note on each photo and a Fix button for the shape and the light.
checks.minSideHelp: A photo with a shorter side is "Too small".
checks.sharpnessMinHelp: Higher is stricter: below this the photo is "Blurry".
checks.darkBelowHelp: Average brightness below this is "Too dark".
checks.ratioTolerancePctHelp: How far from 4:5 a photo may be.
checks.edgeBusyHelp: Lower notices a garment running off the frame sooner.

ui.readOnly: You can look but not change these.

err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile. The page was refreshed.

vid.title: Video (optional)
vid.help: A short clip on the model sells better. The product page shows a picture with a play button; the player loads only when a customer taps.
vid.confirmRemove: Take this video off the product? The file stays in the library.
vid.badLink: This is not a YouTube, Vimeo or Facebook link.
vid.providers: YouTube, Vimeo or Facebook. Google needs the length.
vid.clipHelp: MP4, MOV or WebM, up to {mb} MB. It is stored as it is.

checks.d: Whether a video can be added to a product and which kinds.
checks.onHelp: While off, no video can be added and none shows on the product page.
checks.playOnTap: Load the player only on tap
checks.playOnTapHelp: Keeps the product page fast. Recommended.
checks.providersHelp: Which sites a link may come from.

ui.readOnly: You can look but not change these.

err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile. The page was refreshed.

faq.title: FAQs
faq.sub: Questions and answers that show on product pages: on one product, on every product of a category, or on all.
faq.off: FAQs are not shown in the shop yet. You can write them now; turn them on under More options.
faq.question: Question
faq.sec_CATEGORY_sub: Added to every product of the category by itself
faq.both: Write both the question and the answer.
faq.confirmArchive: Archive this FAQ? It stops showing; it stays here under Archived.
faq.makeNote: Copies the question and your answer into an FAQ. The customer question stays as it is.

checks.d: Whether the shop shows FAQs on product pages.
checks.onHelp: While off, no FAQ shows in the shop.
checks.includeShopHelp: Off means only the product's own and its category's.
checks.maxHelp: Product first, then category, then shop-wide.
checks.markupHelp: Needs the shop's FAQ markup switch too (Website › SEO).

ui.readOnly: You can look but not change these.

err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile. The page was refreshed.

erpc.title: Size chart from the ERP
erpc.help: The ERP can send a size chart for each style. Press the button to get it and use it as this product's size chart. Your own edits to a chart are never overwritten by a later ERP change.
erpc.off: The ERP size chart is off.
erpc.noStyle: This product has no ERP style code, so there is no chart to get.
erpc.available: The ERP chart for style {style} is here: {sizes}. Source: {source}.
erpc.applied: This product uses the ERP chart for style {style}.
erpc.newer: The ERP sent a newer chart for style {style}. Your chart is unchanged; use the newer one to make a new chart.
erpc.used: Size chart set from the ERP
erpc.notShipped: The ERP does not send size charts yet. Choose Sample under More options to try it.
erpc.noErpChart: The ERP has no chart for this style.
erpc.noGarment: Choose a category with a garment type first.

checks.d: Whether the product screens offer the ERP's size chart.
checks.onHelp: While off, the button is not shown.
checks.sourceHelp: Sample until the ERP ships size charts.

ui.readOnly: You can look but not change these.

err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile. The page was refreshed.

demo.moreSub: Make demo products, add the demo catalogue, the price a demo product shows and the list of demo products made.
demo.title: Demo products
demo.sub: Sample products that fill every category, sub-category and sub-sub-category, so the shop never looks empty while real products arrive.
demo.madeTotal: {all} made in total · {empty} categories have no real product yet
demo.whereSub: Category › sub-category › sub-sub-category. Turn any part off.
demo.autoLabel: Hide demo when a category has enough real products
demo.autoHelp: Checked on the smallest category each demo item sits in
demo.popupSub: Shown when a customer taps Add to bag or Order now on a demo product, before any address is asked.
demo.never_google: go to Google (hidden from search, not in the sitemap)
demo.never_feeds: go to the Shopping or Facebook product feeds
demo.never_reports: appear in reports or the dashboard
demo.stale: Someone changed this meanwhile. The page was refreshed.
demo.readOnly: You can look but not change these.
demo.itemsNone: None made yet. Press Make demo products.
demo.confirmDraft: Turn this sample into an ordinary draft product? It leaves the demo list and its sample prices are switched off. You finish it and publish it yourself.
demo.drafted: It is now a draft product

wiz.saveNote: Every step saves by itself into the draft. Nothing is on the shop until you publish in step 8.
wiz.preview: How it looks on a phone
wiz.demoNote: Sample products in this category can be turned off in

start.name: Pick from ERP
start.title: Pick from ERP
start.why: All stock comes from the ERP, so you start here. Styles that are in the ERP but not on the shop are listed first.

basics.name: Name & category
basics.title: Name & category
basics.why: Customers and Google see the name first. The category decides which details you fill in.

colours.name: Colours & sizes
colours.title: Colours & sizes
colours.why: Pick which ERP colours and sizes show on the shop. Stock is read only and updates by itself.

photos.name: Photos & video
photos.title: Photos & video
photos.why: Each colour has its own photos. Add many at once; every photo is made light and checked for you. Video is optional.

prices.name: Price
prices.title: Price
prices.why: Buying price comes from the ERP; the selling price is yours. Profit shows at once so nothing goes live at a wrong price.

size.name: Description & size chart
size.title: Description & size chart
size.why: Good text and the right size chart mean fewer questions and fewer exchanges.

search.name: Google & link
search.title: Google & link
search.why: The right name, link and text help you come up in Google. See exactly how it will look.

publish.name: Check & publish
publish.title: Check & publish
publish.why: See what is done and what is left. Even with gaps the draft stays saved.

head.title: Add product
head.sub: 8 short steps. Every step saves by itself — leave any time and come back to the same place. The phone on the right shows what customers will see.

ck.need: Publish needs a front photo for every colour and a confirmed price. Other gaps only warn.

wiz.pickFirst: Pick a style from the ERP first.
wiz.noWrite: You can look at this draft but not change it.

again.title: Start again?
again.text: This draft is put away (not deleted) and you start a fresh one. You can bring it back from the Products list.

quick.title: Quick import
quick.text: Paste ERP style codes, one per line or separated by commas. Each one comes in as a draft; nothing goes on the shop.

pick.notOnShop: In the ERP, not on the shop ({n})
pick.truncated: the list is cut; search to find more
pick.noMatch: No ERP style matches. Try another code.
pick.noErp: The ERP is not connected, so no styles can be listed. You can still start without the ERP.
pick.bottomHint: A set is one listing: the top and the bottom each keep their own sizes and stock.
pick.withoutHint: Stock shows 0 until the style is in the ERP.
pick.needBottom: Pick the bottom piece of the set first.
pick.blocked: This style cannot come in yet. Read the note below it.
pick.imported: {code} came in as a draft. Nothing is on the shop.

block.ERP_V5: The ERP does not send styles in the new form yet.
block.COLOUR_MISSING: A colour of this style is not in your colour list yet.
block.SKU_IN_OTHER_PRODUCT: A SKU of this style is already in another product.
block.ROW_NOT_ACCEPTED: The ERP sent a row the shop cannot take.
block.NOTHING_TO_IMPORT: There is nothing new to bring in.
block.ERP_ON_PRACTICE: The ERP is on practice mode.

name.siteNameHint: Suggested from brand + type. The ERP name stays inside.
name.detailsNote: Change the category and these questions change too (polo: collar and GSM; denim: rise and stretch).
name.noTags: No tags yet. Add them under Products › Structure.
name.needName: Give the product a name of at least 3 letters.

col.note: Stock is read only and updates by itself. A size or colour you untick stays off the shop; nothing is deleted.
col.siteNamesHint: Leave empty to use the colour list’s own name.
col.setNoBottom: No bottom piece picked yet. Go back to step 1.
col.linkNote_SAME: Choosing a colour picks it for both pieces.
col.linkNote_ANY: The customer picks the colour of the top and of the bottom on their own.
col.bgradeHave: {n} B-grade pieces in the ERP. Show them as a separate “Outlet” listing at a lower price.
col.bgradeNone: No B-grade pieces for this style in the ERP.
col.noneShown: Keep at least one colour on the shop.

ph.videoHint: A 15-second clip on the model sells better.
ph.needFront: No front photo yet for: {colours}. Publishing needs one for every colour.
ph.allFront: Every colour has a front photo.
ph.ckQualityOn: Photo checks are on: each photo is looked at for size, light and ratio
ph.ckQualityOff: Photo checks are off (switch them on in More options)
ph.gap_colours: No colour on the shop yet
ph.gap_photos: A colour has no front photo
ph.note: This is how a shopper’s phone will show it. Nothing is on the shop until you publish.

price.compareHint: Optional. Must be more than the selling price.
price.noRight: You do not have the right to see or set prices. Ask the owner.
price.belowCost: The selling price is not above the buying price.
price.crossedBad: The crossed-out price must be more than the selling price.
price.confirmed: Price confirmed. It is set on every kept size and colour.
price.mustConfirm: Confirm the price to finish this step. Sale, coupon and combo prices come from Rules, not from here.

txt.descHint: What the fabric feels like, how it fits and when to wear it. At least 40 letters.
txt.chartNewNote: Make a new chart in Size charts (inches, cm works itself out), then pick it here.
txt.finderNote: Which size fits which height and weight. Customers type theirs and get a size.
txt.faqCat: {n} questions from the category also show here.
txt.faqNone: No question for this product yet.
txt.shortDesc: The description is still short (under 40 letters).

google.keywordHint: What a shopper would type in Google.
google.slugHint: If you change it later, the old link still leads here.
google.slugTaken: This link is taken by another product.
google.title: Google title
google.descTemplate: {name}: made for everyday wear. Cash on delivery in Bangladesh, check at the door and easy exchange.
google.descEmpty: The description Google shows will appear here.
google.ck_keyword: The focus keyword is in the title
google.ck_ownText: The page has its own text (80 letters or more)
google.ck_alt: Every colour has a front photo to carry the alt text
google.ck_slug: The link is short (up to 50 letters)
google.ck_place: The description names the place (Bangladesh, Dhaka)
google.note: The checks only advise; they never stop publishing.

pub.need: Publish needs a front photo for every colour and a confirmed price. Other gaps only warn.
pub.ck_photos: Front photo for every colour: done
pub.ck_start_bottom: Pick the bottom piece of the set (step 1)
pub.ck_basics_name: Name and category are not done (step 2)
pub.ck_photos_photos: A colour has no front photo (step 4)
pub.ck_search_google: The Google title or description is empty (step 7)
pub.gap_NO_COLOUR: Keep at least one colour on the shop.
pub.gap_FRONT_PHOTO: Every colour needs a front photo.
pub.bgrade: {n} B-grade pieces will be listed separately as “Outlet”.
pub.demo: Hide demo products in this category? ({n} showing)
pub.demoNote: Sample items show there now. Your real product takes their place when it goes live, by the rules in Products › Demo products.
pub.noRight: You may not publish. Ask someone who can; the draft stays saved.
pub.whenHint: Pick a time in the future for “Publish at”. The shop puts it live then, by itself.
pub.blocked: Publishing waits for a front photo on every colour and a confirmed price.
pub.liveDone: The product is live on the shop.
pub.scheduledDone: Scheduled. The shop puts it live at that time.

insight.best: {name} is your best seller ({n} pieces in 30 days). {sold} pieces sold on the shop in 30 days.
insight.notSelling: {n} products on the shop sold nothing in 30 days — push them down in Shop ranking or put them in a combo.
insight.none: Nothing has sold in the last 30 days yet. Your best seller and the products that sold nothing show here once orders come in.

products.introCount: {n} products · stock and buying prices come from the ERP
products.introSynced: {n} products · stock and buying prices come from the ERP (synced {ago} ago)

v5.stockNote: Stock is read-only, synced from the ERP

sales.daily: Pieces sold each day, last 30 days

seo.tip_title: Keep the title between 30 and 60 letters
seo.tip_keyword: Add the word “{word}” — people search for it
seo.tip_place: Mention Bangladesh or cash on delivery in the description
seo.tip_slug: A shorter web address (slug) is better
seo.tip_photos: More photos with alt text help Google Images

pricing.sub: The lowest selling price of the sizes below, the ERP buying price and what is left.
pricing.low: Margin is below your {n}% minimum. After courier, COD fee and packaging very little is left.

google.none: No tracked search word for this page yet

err.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong tries — wait a little and try again
